comment: Original GoldSource engine/game sources. The project forks every upstream under github.com/theodorecharles so the exact source is controlled and pinned. Build scripts clone the forks (or consume npm packages built from them); wasm-games itself never commits the upstream source.

sources.name: webxash3d-fwgs
sources.purpose: Emscripten build of Xash3D-FWGS + HL/CS clients; produces the prebuilt WASM packages the adapter loads.
sources.notes: Engine WASM + game client/server DLLs come from these npm packages today. Migrating to build-from-fork is follow-up.

sources.name: xash3d-fwgs
sources.purpose: Upstream GoldSource-compatible engine. Patched by patches/xash-no-quit.patch + patches/xash-framework-contract.patch.

sources.name: hlsdk-portable
sources.usedVia: npm package hlsdk-portable@0.1.2 for Half-Life/Blue Shift; scripts/build-opfor-framework.sh at opfor commit 613eb55d5bcd257219c881297d1d43c1da4a7445 for Opposing Force
sources.purpose: Portable Half-Life SDK — the HL/Blue Shift game logic plus the expansion-specific Opposing Force client/server DLLs.

sources.name: cs16-client
sources.purpose: Counter-Strike 1.6 client. Its 3rdparty/mainui_cpp submodule builds the CS menu.

sources.name: mainui_cpp
sources.usedVia: cs16-client submodule (3rdparty/mainui_cpp), overridden to the fork in build-cs-menu.sh
sources.purpose: Counter-Strike main-menu library. Patched by games/counter-strike/patches/cs16/main-menu.patch (Join Game button, no quit/previews).

sources.name: yapb
sources.purpose: Native AI players for the pinned Counter-Strike Xash3D dedicated host.
